page.overview:
Who is Nelson Blindspot?

"Nelson is a Piston Cup cameraman. After twenty years of keeping the leaders in his cross hairs, he is the only car in the world who can keep pace with the likes of Strip Weathers, Chick Hicks, and Lightning McQueen, and all without even breaking a sweat."
